root_idea.summary: The root expresses two related orientations: traversing or cutting through something, and the middle or interior of something.
root_idea.development: The lexical development connects passage through the middle with crossing, leaving something behind, and passing beyond it. From this arise related senses of permissibility, validity, figurative transfer, and—by metaphor—providing water for passage.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form III perfect citation form جَاوَزَ.
Displayed under the normalized Form VI perfect citation form تَجَاوَزَ rather than the inflected Quranic form نَتَجَاوَزُ.

senses.definition: To cross or pass beyond a thing, leaving it behind.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive crossing or passing construction; the Quranic uses include crossing a place or body of water and passing beyond a stopping-point.

senses.definition: To lead or take someone across; to make someone pass through or beyond something.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive construction in which a person or group is led across a route, boundary, or obstacle.

senses.definition: To pass over an offense without punishment; to overlook or forgive.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ for passing over a person’s offense or the offense itself; the Quranic use describes divine overlooking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go or pass through, in, along, or beyond a place or road; to leave it behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I usage with a place, road, or comparable object; the related expressions include passing by or over something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of money or a thing: to pass as current or be accepted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of currency that circulates or is accepted as valid payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be allowable, lawful, valid, or effective.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a sale, marriage, contract, or other act that passes as legally sound or has effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exceed or transgress a proper limit, measure, or degree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a boundary, limit, measure, or comparable standard; it can describe excess or immoderation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pass from one thing to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transition construction using مِنْ ... إِلَى ... or an equivalent expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be easy or accommodating in selling and demanding.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of a person’s disposition toward leniency in commercial dealings.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone or something pass through, across, or beyond a place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV construction; it may describe leading people, animals, or other travelers across a route.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something pass or be current.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of making a name or coin pass as current.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To allow, permit, or hold something to be lawful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV permissive construction, including allowing an act or approving its permissibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grant a license or authorization to transmit and teach what one has received from teachers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical scholarly usage referring to authorization to transmit heard material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To execute, ratify, or give legal effect to a sale, marriage, contract, judgment, or opinion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an authority or judge making an act effective or decreeing it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To provide water sufficient for someone, land, or animals to continue their journey or be watered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized and figurative Form IV usage involving supplying water for a route, field, livestock, or travelers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a gift, present, or grant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension associated with providing what enables a person to proceed or pass onward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the darkness of night: to clear away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form V usage describing the passing or clearing of night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To relax, shorten, or be less exacting in an act or procedure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of performing a prayer briefly or with remission, including doing less than the full measure considered sufficient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accept money without rejecting it for defects or irregularity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of accepting dirhams as they are, including when mixed with inferior pieces or fewer than expected.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bear with something through patience, forgiveness, feigned neglect, or connivance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of treating one affair more leniently than another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To use a trope or figurative expression in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rhetorical usage connected with transferring a word beyond its original application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exceed or transgress a limit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form VI usage equivalent to exceeding a proper boundary or measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feign neglect of an offense or connive at it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct non-punitive or indulgent usage apart from explicitly forgiving the offense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or demand permission from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X seeking authorization to act or proceed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To request a scholarly license to transmit what one has heard and learned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical scholarly usage corresponding to authorization for teaching received material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone for water for land, animals, or a journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage of seeking water sufficient to irrigate, water livestock, or continue along a road.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To approve or find something acceptable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported conventional usage meaning to regard something favorably or as acceptable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle or central part of a thing, including the main part of a desert, camel, or night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of location or central portion; its plural is أَجْوَازٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The walnut or walnut fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A borrowed botanical noun used for the familiar edible fruit and its tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nutmeg, a fragrant medicinal seed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A compound botanical and medical term, distinct from the ordinary noun for a walnut.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Datura or thorn-apple, used as a medicinal substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A compound name for a particular medicinal plant whose seed is described in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nux vomica, a medicinal substance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A compound medical term for a drug associated with the properties of white hellebore.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The coconut or coconut fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A compound botanical term, also called النَّارَجِيل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A constellation, especially Gemini.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained in relation to the constellation’s position across the middle of the sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Orion, the constellation also called الجَبَّارُ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct astronomical application of the same conventional name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of watering or giving drink, especially a single watering of camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun associated with providing water to livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Water supplied to animals, crops, or a traveler for the journey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The water itself, or the quantity supplied so that a person or animal can travel from one watering-place to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A traveler’s pass or safe-conduct document.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A document given to prevent opposition while traveling; this sense is a figurative extension from enabling passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The office or authority of a guardian and marriage affiancer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized legal or social usage concerning guardianship in marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Current or circulating; of money, verses, or proverbs that pass from place to place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial usage describing what is accepted or widely circulated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Allowable, valid, legally sound, or effective.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a contract, sale, marriage, or comparable act that passes as lawful and has effect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beam or crosspiece supporting the ends of roof timbers between two walls.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete architectural noun with plural forms referring to roof-supporting beams.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A draught, single watering, or quantity of water sufficient for a traveler to pass between watering-places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized water-related noun, with distinctions between a draught, a single watering, and a traveler’s supply.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gift or present.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional figurative extension of a provision given to someone for onward passage or travel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Kindness, courtesy, or provisions given to a guest or visiting envoy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer specifically to provisions supplied to a departing guest for a day and a night after hospitality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A way, road, path, or bridge by which one travels from one side or end to another; figuratively, a means to an aim.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The concrete passage may be a road or bridge; the figurative use treats an action or thing as a route to an objective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A privy or place where one performs ablution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized place-name distinct from the general sense of a road or passage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A trope: a word or phrase used beyond its original sense through analogy or another connection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rhetorical term contrasted with حَقِيقَةٌ; it includes metaphor and other transferred usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An authorized agent, executor, or other representative who carries out another’s instructions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May refer to an appointed executor, an authorized trading slave, or a commissioned agent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A guardian and marriage affiancer for a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized legal-social usage equivalent to وَلِيٌّ in the context of arranging marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The manager of an orphan’s affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized fiduciary or guardianship role.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land containing or abounding in walnut trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A geographic adjective or noun describing a place rich in جَوْز, walnuts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who goes or passes along a road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participle describing a traveler or someone penetrating along a route.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who loves to hasten or outstrip others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative specialization of the traveler or passer’s tendency to press ahead.

Giving legal effect or executing an act.
Providing water for land, animals, or travel.
Relaxing or shortening prayer and similar acts.
Accepting money and forbearance or connivance.
Passing over an offense and feigned neglect or connivance.
Transcending an object is covered by exceeding a limit.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the basic passage sense.
Seeking water for land, animals, or travel.
Water supplied to animals, crops, or travelers.
Office of a guardian and marriage affiancer.
Current money and circulating verses or proverbs.
Draught or travel supply of water.
Hospitality and provisions for guests or envoys.
Road, bridge, or figurative means to an aim.
Land containing or abounding in walnut trees.
Editorial label identifying a figurative or tropical form.
One who travels or passes along a road.
Traveling or penetrating along a road is covered by the broader passer sense.

cautions: Lane’s cited Quran passages in the Form IV discussion use historical chapter-number conventions; the quoted crossing expression is associated here with the supplied QAC Form III occurrences, and no modern location is inferred from Lane’s notation.
The Quranic Form III and Form VI senses are kept separate from broader Classical branches of the same root and from related Form I, IV, V, VIII, and X entries.
